title: Verify lane test step fails intermittently under load, green on isolated rerun
symptom: fledge lanes run verify fails at step 3 (test) with a different test binary each time: 2026-11-10 saw '--test change' (1/14 failed), '--test stop', and '--test cases' fail in the lane; each passed fully on an isolated rerun right after (change 14/14, stop 10/10, cases 32/32)
trigger: Full verify lane on a heavily loaded Mac (several agents, load ~75); the --test change instance coincided with two lanes sharing one target dir
expected: The lane's test step reflects real failures only (DRIVE-19)
actual: Intermittent failures that pass on retry; matches the #132 fork/fd-inheritance pattern (ETXTBSY, held checkpoint lock)
impact: Merge path for PR #212 needs lane retries; reported on issue #132; 0.6.0 must fix it (zero open bugs at tag time)
